comparison.objective: Release a camera plate from a cam-clamped mount and place it upright on a pad; candidate depins an internal connector terminal.
comparison.physical_skill: PR tests cam-lever actuation, payload support, mount clearance, and placement. Candidate tests dual-blade tang release maintained during wire withdrawal.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires cam opening, mount clearance, upright pad placement, camera/plate integrity, release, and stability. Candidate requires selective contact removal, neighbor retention, intact crimp/housing, and no bypass.
comparison.reason: Whole-payload cam-clamp release does not test internal contact-latch access or bimanual depinning.
